content.value: Some transactions for Rehan, in his first month of business are as follows: (18)
January 1– Invested tk. 50,000 cash and furniture of 75,000 in business
January 4– Purchased used car for tk. 90,000 cash for use in business
January 10– Purchased supplies on account for tk. 15,000
January 13– Billed customer tk. 21,000 for service provided
January 17– Paid tk. 3,000 cash for advertising and 5,000 as insurance premium
January 21– Received tk. 3,000 cash from customer billed on January 13
January 25– Payments to Account Payable tk. 1,000
January 29– Withdraw tk. 2,000 cash for personal use of owner
